beats.headline: NVDA gains 4.32% in broad semiconductor rally
beats.explanation: No company-specific news accompanied the gain to $208.27 on 1.78x average volume. The move was shared across the sector, with competitors INTC surging 23.60%, AMD rising 13.91%, and QCOM climbing 11.12%, while supplier TSM advanced 5.17%.

beats.headline: NVDA climbs 4.00% following Form 8-K filing
beats.explanation: NVIDIA rose 4.00% to close at $216.61 on 1.55x average volume following an 8-K filing. The advance was company-specific, as competitors AMD fell 3.79% and AVGO slipped 1.08%, though supplier MU gained 5.61%.

beats.headline: NVDA drops 4.63% while competitors rally
beats.explanation: No company news was provided for the decline to $199.57 on 1.87x typical volume. The selloff was company-specific and diverged from competitors QCOM and GOOGL, which surged 15.12% and 9.96% respectively, though customer and competitor MSFT also declined 3.93%.

beats.headline: NVDA rises 4.39% alongside supplier TSM
beats.explanation: No company-specific announcements were reported as the stock rose 4.39% to $235.74 on 1.50x average volume. The upward move was shared with supplier TSM and competitor AVGO, which advanced 4.48% and 5.52% respectively, even as competitor QCOM dropped 6.14%.

beats.headline: NVDA advances 6.26% with supplier strength
beats.explanation: Shares jumped 6.26% to $224.36 with volume reaching 1.76x the 30-day average without company filings or news. Key suppliers MU and TSM also moved higher, up 6.64% and 4.11% respectively, while competitors QCOM and INTC dropped 8.78% and 4.67%.

beats.headline: NVDA falls 3.62% as hardware peers gain
beats.explanation: No company developments accompanied the pullback to $214.75 on 1.33x average volume. The drop was company-specific relative to competitors INTC and AMD, which rose 4.43% and 4.02%, though supplier TSM and customer MSFT fell 2.24% and 3.17%.

beats.headline: NVDA gains 3.65% to $204.12
beats.explanation: No company-specific news explained the 3.65% increase on 1.22x typical volume. Competitor AVGO also advanced 4.83% and supplier MU added 1.11%, whereas competitors GOOGL and MSFT declined 1.39% and 1.41%.

beats.headline: NVDA moves up 4.03% to $210.96
beats.explanation: NVIDIA gained 4.03% with no company-specific catalysts identified. The upward move was largely company-specific, as competitor AMD was up 2.04% but competitor INTC fell 2.40% and supplier MU dropped 1.24%.

beats.headline: NVDA slides 4.99% alongside peer AMD
beats.explanation: Shares declined 4.99% to $196.51 on 1.28x average volume with no company-specific updates. The move was shared with competitor AMD, which dropped 5.17%, and supplier MU, which dropped 2.25%, even as competitor GOOGL rose 2.13%.

beats.headline: NVDA advances 3.44% despite competitor losses
beats.explanation: No company announcements were reported as the stock rose 3.44% to $219.22 on 1.31x average volume. The gain was company-specific, bucking sharp losses from competitors AMD, GOOGL, and QCOM, which fell 7.04%, 4.03%, and 3.16% respectively.

beats.headline: NVDA jumps 8.74% following 10-Q and 8-K filings
beats.explanation: NVIDIA surged 8.74% to $227.98 on heavy volume of 2.48x its 30-day average following the filing of its Form 10-Q and Form 8-K the prior day. Competitors AVGO and INTC also rose 4.49% and 4.36%, while competitor AMD slipped 0.89%.

beats.headline: NVDA pulls back 4.58% following post-filing rally
beats.explanation: After the previous session's surge following its Form 10-Q and 8-K filings, NVIDIA fell 4.58% to $217.55 on 1.62x average volume. The pullback was shared with hardware peers, as competitor INTC declined 2.85% and suppliers TSM and MU fell 2.29% and 0.27%.
